## Summary

Branch `fable/shipforge-gap-fixes` created off `feat/shipforge-datalayer-switch` in `/Users/sheikhmusa/wingmen/projects/shipforge-deployed`. Implemented 11 of 13 gaps across 4 commits; skipped 2 with reasoning below. Final state: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean (0 errors), test suite 179/179 passing (up from 171 baseline), two full `next build` runs (Turbopack, Cache Components/PPR) succeed cleanly. No money-plane files touched (`git diff` confirms zero hits on `entitle`/`unlock`/`user_unlocks`), no schema/migration changes, no deploy.

### Fixed (11)

**Commit `bd60cda`** — data-layer:
- **#11 content.ts mergeRows() allowlist** — `app/lib/content.ts`: guard by the `SECTIONS` allowlist before assigning `row.section` onto the merged object (closes contract-drift gap + `__proto__` edge case); exported `mergeRows` for testability. No dedicated test added — `content.ts` imports `next/cache`/`next/server`, which plain `node --test` can't resolve outside Next's bundler (verified empirically; confirmed this is why no `content.test.ts` existed before).
- **#13 admin invite ttlDays validation** — `app/api/admin/invite/route.ts`: reject non-finite/non-integer/non-positive (400), clamp oversized to 90 days. 7 new tests in `tests/admin-invite.test.ts`.
- **#10 getSitesByIds sequential round-trips** — `app/lib/sitesStore.ts`: `Promise.all` instead of a sequential per-id loop in the pg branch. No test added — this branch (`sfReady()`) has zero coverage in either version (no existing test sets `SHIPFORGE_DB_URL`); pre-existing gap, not introduced.
- **#12 sbFetch docstring** — `app/lib/supabaseRest.ts`: corrected false "throws on non-2xx" claim (doc-only).

**Commit `1905421`** — onboarding/claim:
- **#1 magic-link delivery telemetry** — `app/lib/onboardingFlow.ts` + `app/api/onboarding/start/route.ts` + `app/claim/[token]/ClaimClient.tsx`: moved `S2_email` success telemetry from mint-time (before delivery) to post-delivery in the route handler, mirroring the sibling `tg-issue` route's existing pattern. `ClaimClient` now reads `d.delivered` and shows honest "we couldn't reach your inbox" copy + a Telegram recovery link instead of a false "check your email" screen. Added a regression test in `tests/onboarding-e2e.test.ts` that fails on the old code (asserts exactly one `S2_email:error`, not a false `:ok`, when delivery fails).
- **#2 claim token referrer leak** — same `ClaimClient.tsx`: added `rel="noreferrer"` to the Telegram link; added site-wide `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` via `next.config.ts` `headers()` as defense-in-depth (verified against the installed Next 16.2.9 type defs, not assumed).
- **#4 ClaimClient blank fallback** — same file: added a defensive catch-all render branch for any status outside the known set.

**Commit `3fc14cf`** — rebuild page:
- **#5 unlock dead-loop (critical)** — `app/rebuild/page.tsx` `onUnlock()`: now reads the `/api/unlock` response and only re-runs the pipeline when it wasn't a stub/error; surfaces `j.message` otherwise. Updated the now-false "clicking just unlocks" copy. Purely client-side; `/api/unlock` itself untouched.
- **#6 tier vs result.full mismatch** — same file: `watermarked` and the Unlock CTA's visibility now derive from `result.full` (the worker's own post-run flag) instead of the pre-run `tier` header.

**Commit `1c4c511`** — console:
- **#8 no error boundaries** — added `app/console/error.tsx` and `app/console/[siteId]/error.tsx`, themed to match `DARK_VARS`. Verified via a full `next build` (error.tsx correctness is a Next.js route-convention contract tsc alone doesn't check).
- **#9 EditorClient unsaved-changes guard** — `app/console/[siteId]/edit/EditorClient.tsx`: `beforeunload` handler armed when `history.length > 0`, plus an `onClick` guard on the "← back" link. Left the "optionally persist to sessionStorage" enhancement out per its own "optional" framing in the spec.

No dedicated tests for client-component fixes (#1's ClaimClient half, #5, #6, #8, #9's beforeunload/back-link guard): this repo's test harness (`node --test`, no jsdom/testing-library in `package.json`) has no React-rendering support — confirmed no existing test in the suite imports any `page.tsx`/client component. Relied on typecheck + two full `next build` passes + careful review instead.

### Skipped (2)

- **Rebuild-funnel telemetry** (low/ux) — the fix as specified requires new `onboarding_events` stage values (`capture`/`design`/`render`) not in the DB's `CHECK` constraint (`db/onboarding_events.sql:33-35`, currently `S1_claim_open`..`S6_rebuild` only), which needs a migration — explicitly forbidden ("DO NOT change DB schema or run migrations"). It also collides structurally: `onboarding_id` is `NOT NULL uuid`, but the public `/rebuild` hero flow is fully anonymous with no claim/invite and thus no natural `onboarding_id` — minting a synthetic one per anonymous visit would pollute the funnel-attempt semantics the table was built around (confirmed by reading `ConsoleClient.tsx`'s existing, unrelated `S6_rebuild` emitter, which only fires for already-claimed users with a real `onb` id). This needs a real schema/design decision, not a surgical client-only patch.
- **Cancel affordance / abortRef** (medium/ux) — its own fix_spec explicitly says it's "only safe to ship AFTER (or together with) the 'worker has no res/req disconnect handling' fix" — a separate finding not included in the 13 items given to me. Shipping it alone would, per that same note, make an out-of-scope worker-crash scenario easier to trigger. Flagging for the parent to bundle with that other fix rather than improvising a worker-side change I wasn't asked to make.

### Verification

- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean, 0 errors (checked after every fix cluster, not just at the end).
- `npm test`: 179/179 passing (171 baseline + 8 new: 7 ttlDays cases + 1 delivery-telemetry regression test).
- `npx next build` (Turbopack, Cache Components): succeeds cleanly, twice, confirming the new `error.tsx` files and `next.config.ts` `headers()` change integrate correctly with the live route tree.
- `git diff --stat feat/shipforge-datalayer-switch..HEAD`: 14 files changed, confirmed zero touches on `entitle`/`unlock`/`user_unlocks`/any `.sql` file.

# Shipforge Gap Scan — Synthesis Report

**Scope:** 48 findings across 6 flow segments. 13 were marked auto-fixable; 11 shipped, 2 skipped with reasoning (below). 35 remain gated. Branch `fable/shipforge-gap-fixes` — 4 commits off `feat/shipforge-datalayer-switch`, in `/Users/sheikhmusa/wingmen/projects/shipforge-deployed`, **local only, not pushed** (no upstream tracking).

IDs below (G01–G48) are mine, assigned in scan order, for cross-reference — not in the source data. Two things worth knowing before section 4: **G05, G19, G43 are the same code defect** (`SESSION_SECRET ?? REVALIDATE_SECRET` fallback in `session.ts`/`magiclink.ts`), scored three times at three blast radii. **G28 and G33 are an exact duplicate** (`changeRequestStore.ts`'s missing `account_id` filter, flagged once from console-manage, once from data-layer). One fix each closes the pair/triad — treat this as ~45 distinct defects, not 48.

| Severity | Total | Fixed | Skipped | Gated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | 11 | 1 | 0 | 10 |
| High | 13 | 2 | 0 | 11 |
| Medium | 18 | 5 | 1 | 12 |
| Low | 6 | 3 | 1 | 2 |
| **Total** | **48** | **11** | **2** | **35** |

**10 of 11 criticals are still open.** The fix pass was correctly scoped to safe, non-money, non-schema changes — the dangerous stuff is exactly what's in section 4.

---

## 1. The flow + where it breaks

Visitor pastes a URL (`/rebuild`) → free single-style watermarked clone → **Unlock** (pay) → full 5-style + multipass → merchant claim (email or Telegram deep-link) → account + site linked as owner → `/console` (view, edit, change-requests, refresh).

Worst breaks, in flow order:
- **Front door can wedge shut.** No timeout or cancel on the clone stream (G01) — a stall pins one of only 2 global concurrency slots forever; two stalls and the product is down for everyone.
- **The invite CTA doesn't work.** Email magic-link has zero live transport (G02) — every "check your email" promise sends nothing. Claim redemption and site-linking aren't atomic (G03) — a transient DB blip permanently burns a real invite with no recovery, just a misleading "already claimed."
- **The money moment is a free-for-all.** One cookie gets any visitor the full paid product for free, exempt from the abuse cap too (G18 — see §2).
- **Post-purchase management is mostly theater.** "Refresh my site" 400s on every single click (G25) — wired to a param the route never asks for. Change-request submissions vanish into a queue nothing reads (G26) — every request sits at `queued` forever while the UI promises "shortly."
- **The data layer has a split identity.** The content-edit Telegram bot still writes to the old substrate DB; the app already reads from the new ceayj DB (G32) — bot edits silently never appear live.
- **The master key is shared.** The secret signing every session/magic-link doubles as the Bearer credential for admin-invite/entitle/revalidate (G05/G19/G43) — one leak forges any session and self-grants any entitlement.

---

## 2. Revenue leaks (ranked)

1. **G18 — CRITICAL, OPEN.** Unsigned `wingmen_internal` cookie is a zero-precondition paywall + abuse-cap bypass. `app/api/rebuild/route.ts:75-84` (`isInternal()`) and `app/preview/[style]/page.tsx:70-73` both do a raw string compare on the Cookie header — no HMAC, unlike `wm_sess`/`wm_acct` which the same codebase signs correctly (`session.ts`). Nothing ever mints this cookie server-side. Any visitor: `document.cookie="wingmen_internal=1"` in devtools, or a bare curl header — gets full 5-style + multipass, no watermark, **and** exemption from `checkGlobalDailyCap()` (`route.ts:148`), the one guard built specifically to bound free consumption. *Note: the source finding's `fix_spec` field only contains exploit narrative, not a remediation — flagging that gap in the scan itself. Grounded fix: sign the flag with the same HMAC pattern `session.ts` already uses, or drop the cookie in favor of an authenticated-operator toggle.*

2. **G19 / G43 / G05 — CRITICAL, OPEN** (one defect, three findings). `session.ts:21-27` / `magiclink.ts:15-21`: `SESSION_SECRET ?? REVALIDATE_SECRET ?? "dev-session-secret-change-in-prod"`. `STATUS.md:38` confirms this is live in prod, not hypothetical. `REVALIDATE_SECRET` is also accepted via URL query string on `/api/revalidate` (`route.ts:10-13`) — a query-string secret lands in logs. Whoever obtains it can (a) self-sign a `wm_sess` cookie for any account, and (b) call `/api/entitle` (Bearer-gated by the same secret, defaults to granting all four unlock types) — a complete, zero-payment "purchase" indistinguishable from a legitimate operator grant.

3. **G20 — HIGH, OPEN.** `/api/unlock`'s payment idempotency key is `randomUUID()`-per-request (`route.ts:117`), not derived from anything stable across retries — the route's own comment claims idempotent-safe-to-retry, but two different keys can never engage that guarantee. Client-side, the Unlock button isn't disabled during the unlock POST itself (`page.tsx:510` only guards on `running`, set *after* the fetch resolves). Zero live exploitability today (charge is stubbed) — but this is baked into the exact seam cai will review to go commerce-live, and a double-click will double-charge a real customer the day it flips.

4. **G22 — MEDIUM, OPEN.** `grantEntitlements`'s REST fallback (`entitlements.ts:130-138`) never checks `res.ok`, never try/catches. An RLS denial or 4xx/5xx from PostgREST is swallowed; the caller reports success anyway (`api/entitle/route.ts:67-69`). The reverse leak: customer pays, write fails silently, customer sees the paywall forever. Already flagged once in `STATUS.md:85`, unfixed since.

5. **G21 — MEDIUM, OPEN.** `/api/unlock` has none of `/api/rebuild`'s guard stack — no `clientIp`/`checkRateLimit`/`checkGlobalDailyCap`. Cheap today (pure stub, no provider call), but a blocking precondition: the moment `placeOrderCore`/`confirmPosOrderPaymentCore` are wired in, this is an open door to flood orders or the payment provider at unbounded volume.

6. **G23 — MEDIUM, OPEN.** `shipforge.user_unlocks` RLS is `USING(true) WITH CHECK(true)` (`db/ceayj-tenant/10_shipforge_tables.sql:174-177`) — the one money-relevant table in the schema with no real scoping; every sibling (`accounts`, `site_links`, `sites`) is scoped to `shipforge.current_account()`. App-layer discipline covers it today; the DB gives zero backstop if that ever slips.

7. **G24 — LOW, OPEN.** pg-vs-REST dual data layer (`entitlements.ts` branches on `sfReady()`) can split-brain a customer's entitlement across two physically different tables if `SHIPFORGE_DB_URL` is inconsistently set across instances mid-cutover — reads as "customer paid, still sees the paywall."

8. **G10 — CRITICAL, FIXED.** Unlock CTA was a silent, cost-burning dead loop — `onUnlock()` never read the `/api/unlock` response and always re-ran the full paid pipeline (real Claude spend, one more rate-limit hit, one more daily-cap unit, one more of 2 concurrency slots), granting nothing. Now fixed on the branch — see §3.

9. **G14 — MEDIUM, FIXED.** Client could show an "UNLOCKED" badge over a secretly-downgraded result when the worker's cost kill-switch (`WORKER_ALLOW_FULL`) overrides an entitled session mid-run. Now fixed — see §3.

---

## 3. Fixed on the branch (`fable/shipforge-gap-fixes`)

Independently re-verified, not just taken on the auto-fix pass's word: `git log`/`git diff --stat` match the claimed 14-file diff exactly (confirmed via `git diff --stat feat/shipforge-datalayer-switch..fable/shipforge-gap-fixes`); I re-ran `npx tsc --noEmit` myself — clean, exit 0; re-ran `npm test` myself — **179/179 passing, 0 failures**. The two `next build` runs are as reported by the fix pass, not independently re-run here.

**`bd60cda` — data-layer** (G38, G46, G31, G41 — all safe, non-money):
- **G38** `content.ts` `mergeRows()` now checks the `SECTIONS` allowlist before merging a DB-returned key — closes the contract-drift gap and, incidentally, a `__proto__`-assignment edge case.
- **G46** `/api/admin/invite` rejects non-finite/non-integer/non-positive `ttlDays` (400), clamps oversized values to 90 days. 7 new tests.
- **G31** `getSitesByIds`'s pg branch is `Promise.all` instead of a sequential per-id loop — this also resolves half of the still-open G37 (see §4).
- **G41** `supabaseRest.ts` docstring corrected (falsely claimed it throws on non-2xx).

**`1905421` — onboarding/claim** (G04, G07, G09):
- **G04** `S2_email` telemetry moved from mint-time to post-delivery, mirroring the existing Telegram-route pattern. `ClaimClient.tsx` now reads `d.delivered`, shows honest "we couldn't reach your inbox" copy + a Telegram fallback instead of a false success screen. Regression test added that fails on the old code.
- **G07** `rel="noreferrer"` added to the Telegram deep-link anchor; site-wide `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` added via `next.config.ts` `headers()`.
- **G09** `ClaimClient` now has a catch-all render branch for any unrecognized claim status instead of a blank card.

**`3fc14cf` — rebuild page** (G10, G14 — client-only, `/api/unlock` untouched):
- **G10** `onUnlock()` reads the response, only re-runs the pipeline on real (non-stub) success, surfaces `j.message` otherwise. "Clicking just unlocks" copy corrected.
- **G14** `watermarked` and Unlock-CTA visibility now derive from the worker's own post-run `result.full` instead of the pre-run `tier` header.

**`1c4c511` — console** (G27, G29):
- **G27** Added `app/console/error.tsx` and `app/console/[siteId]/error.tsx`, themed to match the existing dark palette.
- **G29** `EditorClient.tsx` arms a `beforeunload` handler once `history.length > 0`, plus a guard on the "← back" link.

**Skipped (2 of the 13 auto-fixable, withheld with reasoning):**
- **G08** (rebuild-funnel telemetry) — needs new `onboarding_events` stage values not in the DB's `CHECK` constraint — a schema change, out of scope. Also structurally awkward: `onboarding_id` is `NOT NULL`, but `/rebuild` is fully anonymous with no natural id. Needs a design decision, not a client patch.
- **G16** (cancel/abort button) — its own fix-spec says it's only safe "together with" the worker disconnect-handling fix (G13), which wasn't in scope. Shipping it alone makes G13's crash scenario easier to trigger on purpose. Bundle with G13.

Money-plane and schema surfaces correctly untouched: zero hits on `entitle`, `unlock`, `user_unlocks`, or any `.sql` file across all 4 commits.

---

## 4. Gated / needs-decision

### onboarding-clone
- **G01 [CRITICAL, M]** No timeout/cancel on the clone stream — `app/rebuild/page.tsx:79,119-120` (`abortRef` wired, `.abort()` never called, no Cancel button); `app/api/rebuild/route.ts:236-267` (proxy read loop has no read-timeout). No `vercel.json`/`maxDuration` anywhere. Two stalls exhaust `MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS=2`. Fix: client abort-timer + Cancel button + unmount cleanup; server deadline around the read loop with terminal error + `releaseJobSlot()`; explicit Vercel duration config.
- **G02 [CRITICAL, M]** No live email transport — `app/lib/magicDelivery.ts:19-24,59-72` (transport singleton set only from test code); zero email-SDK dependency in `package.json`. Fix: wire Resend/Postmark via `setMagicTransport()` at startup behind `MAGICLINK_LIVE`.
- **G03 [CRITICAL, M]** Claim redemption + site-link creation non-atomic — `onboardingFlow.ts:101-114`; `shipforgeDb.ts:49-51` (`sys()`) and `:61-66` (`withAccount()`) each open their own transaction, no shared one; no try/catch anywhere in the chain. Fix: one atomic SECURITY DEFINER transaction (mirror `mint_claim_token`), or an idempotent-repair branch on same-account replay; wrap the route call; real contact link on the error page.
- **G05 [HIGH, S]** — triad with G19/G43, see §2 and §5.
- **G06 [MEDIUM, M]** Email magic-link is a bare, replayable GET — `app/api/onboarding/verify/route.ts:25-42`. Telegram already got crawler-safe handling (`telegramDelivery.ts:50-53`); email never did. Fix: same-page POST/click confirmation before `completeOnboarding()`. Ship with G02 — closely related to G48, one fix should cover both.

### preview-rebuild
- **G11 [HIGH, L]** Preview URLs die on every tunnel restart — `worker/run-tunnel.sh:44-62` silently falls back to an ephemeral hostname; `worker/server.mjs:611-616` bakes it into every delivered URL; nothing re-pins Vercel's `WORKER_URL`. Already hit prod (`reports/fastrans-preflight-journey.md`); still open per `STATUS.md:56`. Fix: durable hostname (Tailscale Funnel / named Cloudflare tunnel) as the only prod mode + a drift-watcher. Infra change, not a code diff.
- **G12 [HIGH, M]** No e2e pipeline timeout — `rebuildPipeline.ts:139-172`, `worker/server.mjs:516-544` await `child.on('close')` with no deadline; up to 7 chained Claude calls on a `full` run. Fix: hard wall-clock deadline per stage, SIGKILL + refund slot on expiry. Needs real p99 data to tune.
- **G13 [HIGH, M]** Worker has no res/req disconnect handling — `worker/server.mjs` `handleRebuild()`/`send()` (1054-1056): zero `res.on('error')`, zero `req.on('close')`. A mid-stream drop can crash the single shared worker process, killing every concurrent user's job. Fix: attach both handlers, kill child tree + release slot once. Needs a live smoke test — real availability blast radius on paid traffic.
- **G15 [MEDIUM, M]** Paid "full" runs never timed through the live edge; `cacheComponents:true` removed the `maxDuration` lever. Own tracker flags it unresolved (`STATUS.md:60`, "test before selling full"). Fix: one real live `full` request, measure against the account's duration ceiling; restructure if needed.
- **G17 [MEDIUM, M]** Progress UI silent for minutes — both pipeline files discard `rebuild.py`'s rich per-call stderr progress via a no-op callback. A stuck request and a slow one look identical. Fix: thread live per-line progress into the NDJSON stream (architecture change, real async-correctness risk). Cheaper mitigation: client-side elapsed-time counter, shippable independently.

### entitle-money
- **G18 [CRITICAL, M]**, **G19 [CRITICAL, M]**, **G20 [HIGH, M]**, **G22 [MEDIUM, S]**, **G24 [LOW, S]** — full detail in §2.
- **G21 [MEDIUM, S]** `/api/unlock` has zero rate-limiting, unlike `/api/rebuild`'s full guard stack. Apply the same `clientIp`/`checkRateLimit` pattern before commerce-live.
- **G23 [MEDIUM, M]** `user_unlocks` RLS is `USING(true) WITH CHECK(true)` — `db/ceayj-tenant/10_shipforge_tables.sql:174-177`. Flag for cai/money-review to ratify or close via a session-GUC. Live prod RLS change, not a blind auto-fix.

### console-manage
- **G25 [CRITICAL, M]** "Refresh my site" always 400s — `ConsoleClient.tsx:52-56` POSTs `{siteId}` to `/api/rebuild`, which requires `{url,style}` (`route.ts:86-103`); never worked since introduced (`da125d2`), no error state surfaces it. Fix: decide real semantics (re-run stored source URL? re-trigger `vercel_project_id` deploy?), wire a siteId-aware account-scoped endpoint; add visible error state regardless.
- **G26 [CRITICAL, L]** Change-request queue has no consumer — `app/api/console/change-request/route.ts:56-63` only inserts `status='queued'`; `bot/pilot_nlmap.py` (the pipeline the comment claims handles it) is CLI-only, unwired. Every request stuck forever, UI promises "shortly" regardless. Fix: build the missing consumer or wire a real operator notification; stop promising delivery until one exists.
- **G28≡G33 [HIGH, S]** `listChangeRequestsForAccount`'s pg query has no `account_id` filter — `changeRequestStore.ts:62-69` filters only `site_id`, relying entirely on RLS; the REST fallback and the sibling `getSiteForAccount` both filter explicitly. Untested: no test exercises two accounts on one site, and the pg branch actually deployed has zero coverage in either test suite. Fix: add `and account_id = ${accountId}`; add a two-account-same-site test against the pg path.
- **G30 [MEDIUM, L]** No invite/revoke/rename/unlink surface — `siteLinkStore.ts:23-49` already supports `editor`/`viewer` roles with no caller ever using them. Reads as an accidental gap, not a stated roadmap item (unlike `EntitlementPanel.tsx`'s explicit stub). Fix: minimal "Share access" panel, or an explicit "coming soon."

### data-layer
- **G32 [CRITICAL, M]** Content-edit bot never ported to ceayj — `bot/store.py:29,39` hardcoded to the old substrate; `content.ts:119-127` reads from ceayj post-cutover. `@wingmendevbot` edits silently never appear live. Fix: give `bot/store.py` its own scoped ceayj connection, or route writes through an authenticated Next API calling `shipforgeDb.ts` — one write path for `site_content`.
- **G34 [HIGH, S]** REST fallback leaks the real `vercel_project_id` the pg path deliberately redacts (CAI-454) — `sitesStore.ts:20-21,42-46,126-131` vs `25,34-40`. No live leak today, contract only holds on one of two paths. Fix: mirror the redaction in the REST branch.
- **G35 [HIGH, M]** No error handling in any pg-path branch of `sitesStore.ts`/`content.ts` — vs. `entitlements.ts`, which wraps every branch, proving the pattern was known. No `error.tsx` existed before this branch's G27 fix. Fix: wrap pg-path bodies in try/catch resolving to the same safe default the REST branch returns.
- **G36 [MEDIUM, S]** `ready()` is presence-only, no live health check, no telemetry on which path served a request — `shipforgeDb.ts:25-27`. Fix: structured logging per `sfReady()`-false branch; boot-time assertion `SHIPFORGE_DB_URL` is set in prod.
- **G37 [MEDIUM, M]** *(partially resolved by this branch)* `getSiteForAccount`'s pg branch still runs two sequential statements where its REST sibling runs concurrently (`sitesStore.ts:68-85` vs `87-104`) — this half is still open. The other half (`getSitesByIds`'s N-round-trip loop) is the same defect as G31, already fixed with `Promise.all` — don't re-spec that part. Fix: collapse the two statements into one query or `Promise.all` them.
- **G39 [MEDIUM, S]** `SHIPFORGE_DB_MAX` (default 4) untuned against the Supabase pooler's real capacity and Vercel fan-out — `shipforgeDb.ts:35`, no written capacity plan anywhere. Fix: confirm pooler mode/ceiling, right-size, document.
- **G40 [LOW, S]** Raw secrets (DB URL with password, service-role key) passed as plain args into `"use cache"` functions solely as a cache-key discriminator — `content.ts:95,98,122,72,124-126`. Fix: replace with a non-secret hash/discriminator.

### claim-admin
- **G42 [CRITICAL, M]** Silent substrate-commingling fallback — `shipforgeDb.ts:25-27`'s presence-only `ready()`; `claimStore.ts`, `siteLinkStore.ts`, `accountStore.ts` all fall back to the **shared fleet substrate** (`tscuymavysscrvoberrr`, Sydney), not ceayj, if `SHIPFORGE_DB_URL` is ever unset. No attacker needed — an ordinary env slip writes real client rows into the wrong project. Direct TENANT-RESIDENCY-001 exposure. Fix: fail-loud/503 in prod when unset; page operator on `sfReady()==false`; delete the REST fallback branches once `30_substrate_decommission.sql` is applied.
- **G43 [CRITICAL, M]** — triad with G05/G19, see §2 and §5.
- **G44 [HIGH, M]** No single-owner enforcement — a second still-valid claim on an already-claimed site grants a second, unrelated account full owner access. `UNIQUE(account_id, site_id)` only blocks the *same* account double-linking. Only "zero-link" path is tested, never "two accounts, same site." Fix: refuse a 2nd owner-granting claim unless overridden; auto-invalidate other outstanding claims for the same `site_id` on redemption.
- **G45 [HIGH, M]** Admin surface is mint-only — the entire `app/api/admin` tree is one POST route; no list, no revoke, no `revoked_at` column. A leaked link stays redeemable for its full TTL with zero in-product recourse. Fix: `GET /api/admin/claims` (list) + `POST .../revoke`, same Bearer auth, actor-tagged.
- **G47 [MEDIUM, S]** `requestBase()` builds claim/magic-link URLs from client-influenceable `x-forwarded-host` with no allowlist — `requestBase.ts:9-14`; the public `verify/route.ts:16` uses it unguarded. Exploitability against the current edge topology unconfirmed from code alone. Fix: validate against `SITE_PUBLIC_URL`/`VERCEL_URL`/`VERCEL_BRANCH_URL`.
- **G48 [MEDIUM, M]** Email magic-link has no anti-prefetch protection — same defect class as G06. A corporate mail scanner's prefetch burns the claim before the real recipient clicks; "already claimed" (`claim/error/page.tsx`) offers zero recovery even though it was them. Fix: same interstitial as G06 covers this; add a real recovery path to the `claim_already_redeemed` case.

---

## 5. Single highest-leverage fix to ship next

**Fix `isInternal()` — G18, the unsigned `wingmen_internal` cookie.** It's the one finding the scan itself tagged `revenue-leak`, it's live today, and it needs nothing an attacker doesn't already have: `document.cookie="wingmen_internal=1"` in devtools, or a bare curl header, gets the full $-driver product (5-style + multipass, no watermark) for free, plus exemption from the one guard purpose-built to bound free consumption (`checkGlobalDailyCap()`, `route.ts:148`). No credential to leak, no coordinated rollout, no session to forge — just a missing signature check on a flag the codebase already knows how to sign correctly (`session.ts`'s `signSession`/`verifySession` does exactly this for `wm_sess`/`wm_acct`; `isInternal()` in `route.ts:75-84` and `preview/[style]/page.tsx:70-73` just never adopted it). Smallest diff, zero rollout coordination, closes the most concretely exploitable hole in the product.

**Bundle it with G05/G19/G43** (the `SESSION_SECRET ?? REVALIDATE_SECRET` fallback) in the same push if at all possible. It's the architecturally-unrelated second critical, and it's the one that makes every *other* money-plane fix moot on its own: whoever has `REVALIDATE_SECRET` (which leaks into logs via its query-string acceptance on `/api/revalidate`) can forge a session for any account and call `/api/entitle` directly for a zero-payment grant, bypassing every paywall check regardless of how solid the rest of it is. It resolves three tracked findings at once — the best fix-per-line ratio in the whole set. Budget it as a coordinated deploy, not a silent one: rotating the secret invalidates every active session, so it needs an announced window, unlike the cookie fix.
